test.create_query: CREATE TABLE merge_tree_small_blocks (key UInt64, value UInt64, str String, sparse UInt8, arr Array(UInt32)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY key SETTINGS ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.9
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO merge_tree_small_blocks SELECT number, cityHash64(number), toString(number % 1000), number % 100 = 0, range(number % 3) FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(value) FROM merge_tree_small_blocks SETTINGS max_block_size = 16, max_threads = 1
SELECT sum(sparse) FROM merge_tree_small_blocks SETTINGS max_block_size = 16, max_threads = 1
SELECT sum(length(str)) FROM merge_tree_small_blocks SETTINGS max_block_size = 16, max_threads = 1
SELECT sum(length(arr)) FROM merge_tree_small_blocks SETTINGS max_block_size = 16, max_threads = 1
SELECT str, count() FROM merge_tree_small_blocks GROUP BY str FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_block_size = 16, max_threads = 1
